name: SVO Attribute Compression via Parent Delta Encoding
definition: A compression method for volumetric attributes (e.g., color, alpha) stored in Sparse Voxel Octrees (SVOs) that encodes deltas relative to parent node attributes instead of direct spatial neighbors, solving the problem of random access complexity and missing neighbors in 3D sparse data.
summary: SVO Attribute Compression via Parent Delta Encoding compresses volumetric attributes by encoding deltas relative to parent nodes, ensuring streamability and low memory complexity unlike neighbor-based methods.
